source_text: Sermo Dei ad speciosam animam per sensus corporeos — intuitum lectionis et auditum doctrinae — quasi per fenestras apparuit, evocans eam ut procedat foras et extra sensus corporeos desinat esse in carne: Vos autem non estis in carne, sed in spiritu.
pass_a_gloss: Word of-God to fair soul through senses bodily — looking-of reading and hearing of-teaching — as-if through windows appeared, calling-out her that she-may-proceed outdoors and beyond senses bodily may-cease to-be in flesh: You however not are in flesh, but in spirit.
pass_b_english: God’s Word appeared to the fair soul through bodily senses — the gaze of reading and the hearing of teaching — as if through windows, calling her to go outdoors and, beyond bodily senses, to cease being in the flesh: [[You are not in the flesh, but in the spirit >> Bible:Romans 8:9]].
